topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 52 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC20 token; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 9 common project-authored base contract(s) (kept, kept_arbitrum, instance). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
